uploads/science/Scipad/Year 9 Book 1/Wor.searchText: MATTER Particle Theory of Matter - Convection When particles are heated the distance between the particles increases. This means that objects will expand. When liquids or gases expand they become less dense. A gas or liquid which is less dense will rise through a more dense gas or liquid.
